```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: Proximal tube connected
    Given the proximal tube is connected
    When the system is initialized
    Then the system reports the proximal tube is connected

  Scenario: Proximal tube disconnected
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected
    When the system is initialized
    Then the system reports the proximal tube is disconnected
    And the "proximal tube disconnected" alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: Obstruction detected
    Given the VTI is 50ml
    When the system is initialized
    Then the system detects obstruction
    And the "obstruction" alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is high

  Scenario: Obstruction not detected
    Given the VTI is 150ml
    When the system is initialized
    Then the system does not detect obstruction
    And the "obstruction" alarm is inactive

  Scenario: Leakage computation
    Given the sensor readings are 10ml/min
    When the system is initialized
    Then the system computes the amount of leakage as 10ml/min

  Scenario Outline: Proximal tube disconnect alarm priority
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected
    When the system is initialized
    Then the alarm priority is medium

    Examples:
      | alarm_priority |
      | medium         |
      | high           |
      | low            |

  Scenario Outline: Obstruction alarm priority
    Given the VTI is 50ml
    When the system is initialized
    Then the alarm priority is high

    Examples:
      | alarm_priority |
      | high           |
      | medium         |
      | low            |

  Scenario Outline: Leakage computation with invalid values
    Given the sensor readings are <sensor_readings>
    When the system is initialized
    Then the system computes the amount of leakage as <leakage>

    Examples:
      | sensor_readings | leakage |
      | 0               | 0       |
      | -1              | -1      |
      | 1000            | 1000    |

  Scenario Outline: VTI exactly 100ml when tube disconnected
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected
    And the VTI is 100ml
    When the system is initialized
    Then the system reports the proximal tube is disconnected
    And the "proximal tube disconnected" alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is medium

    Examples:
      | VTI |
      | 100 |
```
